##### Project general facts

Avelia at The Valley presents an elegant architectural expression shaped by the vast desert landscapes, lush meadows, and gentle horizons that characterize this serene master community. The villas feature refined contemporary forms softened by natural tones and organic lines, blending harmoniously with the surrounding greenery. Embracing the natural topography of wadis, mountains, and landscaped trails, Avelia creates a tranquil visual identity where each home feels rooted in nature and part of a calm, picturesque environment.

Inside, the 4- and 5-bedroom villas are designed to enhance well-being through open layouts, sunlit interiors, and thoughtful spatial flow. Expansive windows frame views of gardens and parkland, while indoor–outdoor living areas encourage a balanced lifestyle connected to the landscape. Natural palettes and contemporary finishes create serene, nurturing spaces ideal for family life, relaxation, and quiet luxury. Every detail supports mindful living—morning rituals, peaceful evenings, and meaningful time spent at home.

Avelia offers a rich collection of amenities inspired by adventure, community, and nature. Residents can enjoy the Falaj Fountain, viewing platforms, stepped terraces, and lush trails that weave through The Valley. The community includes sports courts, the Oasis Play Area, Canopy Walk, Terrace Trails, Plateau Views, themed Central Park, and the Village Market Plaza. Each space is crafted to inspire discovery—whether through energising activities, family-friendly outdoor moments, or peaceful walks beneath shaded canopies.

Each villa is finished with high-quality materials that complement the natural aesthetic of the community. Kitchens are fully fitted with essential built-in elements for daily convenience, offering functional and modern culinary spaces. Homes are handed over unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize interiors according to their lifestyle while enjoying a premium foundation crafted with care and attention to detail.

##### Location description and benefits

The Valley by Emaar is a captivating and dynamic master-planned community located in Dubai. This exceptional development offers a diverse range of residential options, creating a harmonious and vibrant neighborhood for families and individuals alike.

The community boasts a wealth of amenities and facilities to enhance the living experience of its residents. State-of-the-art fitness centers, sports courts, swimming pools, and dining outlets are just a few of the offerings that cater to a well-rounded and fulfilling lifestyle.

Furthermore, The Valley's strategic location provides easy access to major transportation routes, connecting residents to key destinations within Dubai. The community is also within proximity to schools, healthcare facilities, retail centers, and leisure destinations, ensuring that residents have everything they need right at their doorstep.
